decisions.reason: The permission warning accurately preserves the Android 'Báo thức và lời nhắc' setting name and color tag.
The current two-line text correctly explains delayed notifications and instructs granting the alarm/reminder permission in settings.
'Cài đặt 「Báo thức và lời nhắc」' accurately preserves the platform setting label.
The permission-granted state, device-usage caveat, color tag, and newline are all preserved accurately.
训练员名片 denotes a Trainer card; the current text keeps Trainer but drops 名片 and the source separator, losing the card concept.
转换 denotes conversion rather than a generic exchange; 'Chuyển đổi' preserves the menu function more precisely than 'Đổi'.
'Tự xóa dữ liệu cốt truyện' accurately conveys automatic deletion of story-related data.
'Tự xóa dữ liệu sự kiện' accurately conveys automatic deletion of event-related data.
'Tự xóa dữ liệu trình diễn' accurately conveys automatic deletion of performance-related data.
The current text accurately conveys automatic deletion of race-related data and uses the required race terminology.
